core.title: Pigtail Bar Cabinet Latch, Acorn ALKBR
tags: Acorn Black Flush Door Cabinet Latches

text.description_html:
Acorn ALKBR, Pigtail Smooth Iron Lightweight Door Latch

The Acorn ALKBR Cabinet Latch has a traditional pigtail style end for easy handling. For use with Flush Cabinet Doors where the face of the door is flush with the cabinet's face. Just attach the latch and catch plates to the cabinet and doors faces with the included finish matched screws. The smooth iron finish has a flat black appearance that is typical of early American styling.

Specifications of the Acorn ALKBR Cabinet Latch:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Width as installed: 2-1/16"
  • Height: 2-5/8"
  • Width of plates: 5/8"
  • Length of handle from center of installation hole to beginning of pigtail: 1-1/2"

Sold Individually
